title: christmas stockings
text: christmas stockings. I got two of these, one each for my grandsons... I just got to see them at my daughters house... they are suprisingly good quality and came personalized so quickly.  I am really pleased.  They are an excellent size - measurements give are accurate - though I think the stockings are actually a tad larger.  The names were embroidered - not hot pasted or other cheap method.  These are going to last their whole lives.  That is so nice.  I wouldn't hesitate to get these if you're thinking of upgrading or just starting out right, these are worthy of consideration in my opinion.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info was helpful to you!

product_metadata.title: Needlepoint Christmas Stocking: Decorating The Tree
features: Needlepoint Christmas Stocking: Decorating the Tree
Stocking made of red velvet cuff and back. Hand sewn needlepoint design.
Measures 21.5" from toe to opposite corner (good size!) and is 6.5" wide
Can be personalized with up to 12 characters. Price includes personalization.
description: MerryStockings Needlepoint stockings are made with exquisite detail, the characters are sewn by hand. See the additional images for a close up on the character. Needlepoint stockings measure 6.5" wide by 21.5" long - these stockings are a good size and can be stuffed with lots of Christmas goodies. This stocking features busy elves decorating a Christmas tree.
